title: Bacterial communities associated with activated sludge from municipal wastewater treatment plant (WWTP)
description: This project was associated with the bacterial communities from wastewater treatment plant with combined sewer in the tropical region of south america. Temporary samples were collected from different stages of WWTP over the course of a year.
